title: Embassy correspondence: waiting for the Americans to make a statement

tellings.quote: correspondence there's actually a a document that says we're waiting for the Americans to make a statement.

plain: In the 1950s, letters passing through the Canadian embassy in Washington included a document saying, in Grant Cameron's words, "we're waiting for the Americans to make a statement." Cameron is a UFO researcher, and he tells Michels about it from the personal files of Wilbert B. Smith, a Canadian official. He links it to Smith and to Omond Solandt, a Canadian figure of the same period. If true, it would mean Canada knew something about UFOs and was leaving it to the United States to announce it first.
